label: Day-trader daily setups
notes: A scan is a list of charts that match a rule, not a list of stocks to buy.

scans.label: 20-day closing-high breakout
scans.rule: Closed above the highest close of the prior 20 days

scans.label: Bull flag
scans.rule: Up more than 10% over the prior 10 days, then a 5-day range under 5%

scans.label: Reclaimed the 20-day average
scans.rule: Closed back above the 20-day average after closing below it

scans.label: Oversold bounce
scans.rule: RSI was under 30 yesterday and the stock closed higher today
